title: G2.3 - Artifact and Evidence minimal contracts
intent: Add governed Artifact, ArtifactRevision, Claim, Evidence, and VerificationResult data models and domain commands so Run output attaches to Targets and acceptance criteria become verifiable.
scope: Implement the Assurance data spine: content-addressed artifact revisions, immutable evidence records with trust levels, per-criterion claims and verification results, written only through the Go Domain API; extend the native read model and Target Workbench Artifacts/Evidence tabs with real facts.
non_goals: Implement Submission, DeliveryReview, or Acceptance commands (G2.4)
Implement the GitHub Connector, CI IntegrationTask, or IntegrationRun (G2.5)
Emit outbox events for assurance aggregates; the Timeline reads assurance tables directly in this slice
Build the ArtifactContract registry; artifact kinds are a fixed enum for now
Approve, merge, deploy, release, or create a ship record without independent review and explicit user acceptance
acceptance_criteria: Artifact revisions are content-addressed and immutable: each binds content hash, source run/node when present, base revision, and creating principal; revision numbers are monotonic per artifact
Evidence is immutable with explicit trust level: binds object hash, producing principal, kind, and trust level; agent self-reports record as low-trust observations
VerificationResult binds criterion key, claim, and evidence set: verdicts are passed/failed/inconclusive/waived; waived requires an authorized human waiver reference; results bind verifier version
Only the Go Domain API writes assurance facts; commands use the established receipt + audit transaction pattern with deterministic idempotency keys and request-hash conflict rejection
Target Workbench Artifacts and Evidence tabs render server facts via the native read model with honest empty sets; no client fabrication
Contracts synchronized across db/shared/Go/server/UI; fresh migration, focused tests, typecheck, Go tests, and token gates pass with inspectable evidence
accepted_by: Outcome Owner (browser acceptance delegated to Sisyphus; passed)
